LESSON: COMMUNITY LEADERSHIP

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Citizenship and Governance in Kenya
Topic 5.6: Community Leadership

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Community Leadership
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is it important for leaders to have good qualities?
